field.label: Drop query types
field.help: Record types Blocky answers with an empty response instead of forwarding, e.g. AAAA to suppress IPv6 answers on an IPv4-only network. Type a value and press Enter to add it.

field.label: Sources
field.help: Hosts files used for name resolution: local paths (e.g. /etc/hosts) or URLs. Entries are answered directly by Blocky. Type a value and press Enter to add it.

field.label: Hosts TTL
field.help: TTL returned for answers coming from the hosts files.

field.label: Filter loopback
field.help: Ignore loopback entries (127.0.0.1 / ::1) in the hosts files.

field.label: Refresh period
field.help: Interval at which downloaded hosts files are refreshed. Set to 0 to disable periodic refresh.

field.label: Loading strategy
field.help: How hosts files load at startup: blocking waits, failOnError aborts on failure, fast loads in the background.

field.label: Max errors per source
field.help: Parse errors tolerated in a single hosts file before it is treated as invalid. Use -1 to disable the limit.

field.label: Load concurrency
field.help: Maximum number of hosts files processed in parallel.

field.label: Download timeout
field.help: Timeout for downloading each hosts file URL.

field.label: Download attempts
field.help: Number of times to retry a failed hosts file download.

field.label: Download cooldown
field.help: Wait time between failed hosts file download attempts.

field.label: Use ECS as client
field.help: When a query carries an EDNS Client Subnet option, use that address (instead of the sender's) for client-group matching.

field.label: Forward ECS
field.help: Forward the EDNS Client Subnet option to upstream resolvers.

field.label: IPv4 mask
field.help: Add an ECS option to IPv4 queries with this prefix length (0 disables).

field.label: IPv6 mask
field.help: Add an ECS option to IPv6 queries with this prefix length (0 disables).

field.label: Enable DNS64
field.help: Synthesize AAAA records from A records for IPv6-only clients behind a NAT64 gateway. Do not enable if the ECS/query-type filter above drops AAAA, as those queries are filtered before DNS64 can act on them.

field.label: NAT64 prefixes
field.help: IPv6 prefix(es) used to synthesize AAAA records. The well-known prefix is 64:ff9b::/96. Valid lengths: /32, /40, /48, /56, /64, /96. Type a value and press Enter to add it.

field.label: Exclusion set
field.help: IPv6 ranges for which DNS64 will NOT synthesize when the response already contains AAAA records outside this set. Leave empty to use the recommended defaults. Type a value and press Enter to add it.

field.label: Address
field.help: Redis server as host:port. Enables a shared cache and client-name lookups across multiple Blocky instances. Leave empty to disable Redis.

field.label: Username
field.help: Redis username (ACL), if required.

field.label: Password
field.help: Redis password, if required.

field.label: Database
field.help: Redis database index.

field.label: Required
field.help: If enabled, Blocky refuses to start when the Redis connection cannot be established.

field.label: Connection attempts
field.help: Number of attempts to connect to Redis before giving up.

field.label: Connection cooldown
field.help: Wait time between Redis connection attempts.
